verdict.rationale: Sandbox testing is a fair question for a CRM platform with an API and App SDK, but the evidence never documents a sandbox, test, or staging workspace isolated from production data. The in-browser API playground and SDK console logging are adjacent tooling that act on or debug a real workspace, not an isolated environment, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
